name: nexusrag-ci-sample
description: Small deterministic dataset for CI-safe retrieval, citation, fallback, and workspace isolation checks.

corpus.content: Alpha workspace revenue report. Q1 revenue was 10 million USD. Q2 revenue was 12 million USD. The finance owner is Priya.
Alpha product roadmap includes AI search, document citations, workspace audit logs, and a BYOK model key manager for quota resilience.
Beta workspace confidential plan. The amber launch code is never visible to Alpha workspace users.

cases.question: Which roadmap items improve enterprise security and quota resilience?
cases.expected_answer: Workspace audit logs and BYOK model key manager improve security and quota resilience.

cases.question: What is the Beta launch code?
cases.expected_answer: The amber launch code belongs to the Beta workspace.
